question:
**Direction: Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error’.**

And how amorous you become / when your courtship with the / muses is going stronger.
solution:
Here, the erroneous part is **"muses is going stronger."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in the part** "going stronger."**
 
• The meaning of the phrase** "going strong"** is continuing, even after a long time. (बहुत लंबे समय बाद भी चलते रहना)
 
 
• Example: *The company was formed in 1851 and is still **going strong**__.*
 
 
 
• So, we have to replace the word **"stronger" **with** "strong"** to make it grammatically correct.
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.

 

**Correct sentence**: *And how amorous you become when your courtship with the __**muses is going strong**__. *
